 Order

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 435/2023 registered at Police Station - Madhavnagar, District Katni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3),
376(2)(n), 506 of IPC, sections 5(L) read with section 6 of POCSO Act and sections 3(2)(v), 3(2)(v-a)
of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Applicant is in detention since 20/05/2023.

2. As per the prosecution story, it is alleged that applicant has committed rape upon the prosecutrix,
aged below the 18 years therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against him.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 20/05/2023.
Applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated.
It is further submitted that FIR has been lodged after 21 days of the incident.

sentences.text: It is also submitted that prosecutrix has not identified the present applicant.
It is also submitted that name of the applicant is not Ankush Patel but Somnath Patel.

Proseucutrix has filed a written application before this Court in which it is mentioned that real name of the present applicant is Somnath Patel and she has not lodged any report against the present applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
He has no criminal antecedents.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
Learned counsel for the Objector has no objection if the bail is granted to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
